title: Uu Relay RLC channel release
text: The L2 U2N Relay UE shall:
1 >  for each Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID value included in the uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList that is part of the current configuration within the same cell group (LCH release):
2 >  release the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322 , clause 5.1.3;
